text:
remy: heads-up — after the TF apply last night a subset of eu-west GPU nodes intermittently fail keystore decrypts. different symptom than the usual SG issue: packets are being rejected by a NACL. seeing KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied then transient TCP icmp-unreach on 443.
aoife: confirmed. nodes show: "keystore: KMS.Decrypt AccessDenied proxy=10.2.2.22" then "net: write tcp 10.44.9.18:52344->10.2.2.22:443: write: connection reset by peer". warmpool join flaps.
derek: I pulled the TF diff — module/network/nacls.tf replaced the permissive egress 0.0.0.0/0 allow with a tighter list of destination CIDRs for privatelink proxies but also added a DENY rule for ephemeral ports by mistake (rule with higher priority). it looks like the deny is matching return packets for TCP flows from the proxy, causing mid-connection resets.
ops-oncall: opening INC-7001 P1. immediate mitigation options? we can't change SGs to fix this; NACL is the culprit. proposing to insert a temporary NACL allow for ephemeral ports (1024-65535) for the gpu-subnets to the proxy CIDR and then revert once TF PR lands. approval?
remy: approve emergency NACL exception. also need to whitelist the proxy ip ranges in the audit shipper so no telemetry lost.
ops-oncall: applying temporary NACL rule now (aws cli):
```bash
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0f1a2b3c --egress --rule-number 200 --protocol tcp --port-range From=1024,To=65535 --cidr-block 10.2.0.0/16 --rule-action allow --region eu-west-2
```
ci-bot: terraform pipeline detected manual drift and blocked subsequent applies until a reconcile PR is opened.
aoife: after the NACL allow, nodes immediately stopped flapping and warmpool +6 joined. provisioning backlog cleared. :relieved:
sec-bot: security note — NACL changes bypassed protections because the TF module was merged without the new nacl unit tests. filing a policy violation ticket POL-204.
compliance: we also lost a window (~20m) of keystore.decrypt audit events; this hits the compliance retention SLA for eu2. need SIEM backfill and an incident note for auditors.
ops-oncall: logging: opened SIEM ticket SIEM-7002 to re-ingest missing keystore.audit and hsm.audit events from 2026-03-25T02:14:00 to 2026-03-25T02:34:00. tagged compliance-high.
derek: PR ready that removes the mistaken deny and adds explicit ephemeral-ports allow, plus a nacl unit test and a pre-merge check that disallows DENY rules that overlap established return-port ranges: https://git.internal/rw/network/pull/207. it also adds a canary that performs a full KMS handshake (decrypt+encrypt) from a warmed GPU canary image against each privatelink endpoint.
ci-bot: nice — I updated the pipeline to run the canary and the nacl static analyzer before apply. INFRA-7003 created to formalize the preflight.
remy: cost/impact note — autoscaler briefly created fallback nodes in us-east because eu nodes flapped; cross-region pulls for model shards ~430GB, estimated egress +$640. add to RCA.
compliance: please include the SIEM ticket in the auditor timeline; we may need to mark the period as a data gap if re-ingest can't recover everything.
ops-oncall: INC-7001 -> mitigated after NACL allow added. keeping incident open until PR merges and SIEM confirms re-ingest. will update tickets.
sec-bot: PV-204 created, assigning to the committer and repo owners for follow-up on gating.
derek: merging PR once reviews finish; will coordinate with ops to let the pipeline reconcile the manual change (remove the temp rule).
aoife: follow-ups: merge PR, confirm SIEM-7002 backfill, add nacl analyzer to PR checklist, and update runbook to call out NACL-level validation for egress-sensitive changes.
ops-oncall: will update INC-7001 and SIEM-7002 when re-ingest completes. closing note: keep the temp NACL rule until pipeline applies the reconciled state and canary passes for 30m. :thumbsup:
